text.arabic_uthmani: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ يَقُولُ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ أَهَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِيَّاكُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector fused to the following temporal frame
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes the warning and carries it into a reckoning scene. Its payoff is not a new lexical sense, but a boundary effect: the day of gathering is tied to the prior provision discourse as the horizon where that discourse is tested.

topics.headline: resumptive reckoning frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens as a continuation into judgment, not as an isolated report.
topics.reason: The prefixed connector is attached to the temporal opening, and the local clause begins a day-scene dependent on the preceding discourse.

words.gloss_range: accusative temporal frame for a decisive judgment occasion specified by the following gathering clause
words.root_gloss_range: The root ranges from day to appointed time or decisive event; here grammar and scene select event-time rather than ordinary duration
words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمَ}} ({{tr:yawma}}) opens as an accusative time-frame whose governor is left for the listener to recover. The following gathering specifies the day, so {{ar:ي و م}} ({{tr:y-w-m}}) is felt as one bounded judgment event rather than neutral chronology. Its gathering-day frame is recognizable from parallels such as 19:85, where an honored delegation is gathered, but 34:40 repurposes the frame to expose misdirected worship; 25:17 and 10:28 keep worship-accountability in view.

topics.headline: elliptic accusative day-frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening time noun makes the audience supply a remembered or mentioned scene before the gathering verb arrives.
topics.reason: The accusative temporal noun is locally licensed as an adverbial frame, with the governing mention or remembrance left implicit.

topics.headline: decisive event-time, not neutral chronology
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word names a bounded proceeding of accountability rather than a calendar day.
topics.reason: The local frame contains gathering, speech, and worship interrogation, so the time word is narrowed to decisive event-time.

topics.headline: recognized gathering-day field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this day belongs to a recurring accountability pattern where gathering and worship claims are publicly tested.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete gathering-day and worship-accountability parallels, including 19:85, 25:17, and 10:28, and the local wording activates that field.

words.gloss_range: active imperfect gathering with attached plural object, locally carrying compelled public mustering into the judgment scene
words.root_gloss_range: The root ranges around gathering, mustering, driving together, and assembly; here the transitive object and totality context select compelled public gathering
words.prose: {{ar:يَحْشُرُهُمْ}} ({{tr:yaḥshuruhum}}) is active and transitive: the gathered group is carried inside the verb as object, so the scene is imposed on them rather than chosen by them. The suffix also routes the prior plural judgment group from provision discourse into reckoning without over-naming the antecedent. The {{ar:ح ش ر}} ({{tr:ḥ-sh-r}}) range gives the gathering a mustering force, strengthened by the next totality word into a public arena with no escape by dispersal or absence; 18:47 makes that no-one-left-out pressure explicit. The variant person shift heightens divine immediacy but leaves the same defendants gathered, and the completed gathering becomes the platform for the speech that follows.

topics.headline: compelled active gathering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people are acted upon by the gatherer; they are not merely assembling themselves.
topics.reason: The active imperfect has an attached object suffix and a divine subject supplied by context, so the local frame is transitive and externally imposed.

topics.headline: object suffix carries the prior group forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the suffix carries a prior plural group into judgment while later translation should not over-specify the antecedent beyond the licensed judgment group.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL boundary claim is coherent, but attachment support warns that the object suffix should preserve some antecedent ambiguity rather than name a narrower group too confidently.

topics.headline: mustering into a complete arena
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that gathering is intensified into no-escape public mustering before the interrogation begins.
topics.reason: The root range supports mustering or driving together, and the adjacent totality word locally reinforces comprehensive collection; 18:47 is a concrete no-one-left-out parallel.

topics.headline: gathering prepares formal speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the assembly is not background scenery; it is the procedural condition for the direct question.
topics.reason: The complete gathering clause precedes the sequence marker and speech verb, with parallels such as 25:17, 10:28, and 6:22 linking mustering to formal saying.

topics.headline: accepted person-shift variant preserves the gathered object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accepted variant can intensify divine immediacy without changing who is gathered.
topics.reason: The variant shifts the gatherer from third-person narration to first-person divine self-reference, while the attached object remains the same.

words.gloss_range: circumstantial accusative totality describing the gathered group as all together with no relevant remainder outside the scene
words.root_gloss_range: The root ranges around collecting, joining, confluence, and totality; here it supplies exhaustive inclusion to the gathered group
words.prose: {{ar:جَمِيعًۭا}} ({{tr:jamīʿan}}) does not add a second action; it seals the state of the gathered group. After the gathering verb, {{ar:ج م ع}} ({{tr:j-m-ʿ}}) turns assembly into exhaustive inclusion, like scattered parties pulled into one proceeding with no residue outside the scene. The question that follows is therefore public speech after total presence rather than selective accusation.

topics.headline: totality as state of the gathered
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that totality qualifies the gathered defendants themselves, closing any subset reading before speech begins.
topics.reason: The accusative qualifier modifies the gathered object as a circumstantial state, not as a new action or a loose adverb.

topics.headline: second collection root intensifies no-residue gathering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the local double collection effect: one word gathers, and this word seals the gathering as comprehensive.
topics.reason: The adjacent gathering and collection roots stand side by side, and the {{ar:ج م ع}} ({{tr:j-m-ʿ}}) image of pulling scattered parties together gives the totality no-residue force.

topics.headline: complete assembly before public speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the divine question waits until the whole relevant collectivity is present.
topics.reason: The totality word closes the assembly phase before the speech phase, while 4:172 and same-surah 34:26 show the broader gathering-and-adjudication field.

words.gloss_range: sequence particle marking a staged move from total gathering to formal divine speech
words.prose: {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) is the hinge between the completed assembly and the interrogation. It gives the scene procedural distance: first the defendants are gathered completely, then the divine speech begins as a formal next phase.

topics.headline: staged hinge from assembly to interrogation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question is a second formal phase after gathering, not an immediate verb-to-verb continuation.
topics.reason: The independent sequence particle marks delay, rank shift, or procedural progression between the completed assembly and the speech act.

words.gloss_range: active imperfect divine speech introducing an addressee phrase and direct quoted interrogation
words.root_gloss_range: The root ranges around saying, declaring, addressing, and asking; here the gathered scene selects authoritative interrogation
words.prose: {{ar:يَقُولُ}} ({{tr:yaqūlu}}) moves the scene from mustering into voiced examination. The verb governs the angelic addressee and the quoted question, keeping the angels as respondents rather than the worshipping agents. Here {{ar:ق و ل}} ({{tr:q-w-l}}) is not casual speech but formal interrogation that brings hidden devotion into public language; the accepted first-person variant intensifies divine immediacy without changing the question. Parallels such as 5:116 and the later 34:42 verdict speech keep the act forensic.

topics.headline: active speech governing addressee and quotation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb separates the angels as addressees from the worshippers being examined.
topics.reason: The active imperfect governs a li-addressee and a quoted question, and its subject continues from the gathering verb.

topics.headline: saying as public examination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that saying here performs the test of worship attribution rather than reporting casual speech.
topics.reason: The scene is already a total gathering and the following content is an explicit question, so the {{ar:ق و ل}} ({{tr:q-w-l}}) act functions as authoritative interrogation; 25:17, 10:18, and 10:28 support the speech-and-worship accusation field.

topics.headline: divine questioning and verdict sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this speech belongs to a wider pattern of divine examination that later turns into verdict speech.
topics.reason: The accepted variant preserves the same question with first-person divine immediacy, 5:116 gives a direct revered-recipient questioning parallel, and 34:42 continues the speech sequence toward verdict.

words.gloss_range: prefixed preposition locally marking the recipients of the speech verb
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) narrows the role of the following angel noun. Its broader prepositional range is locally constrained by the speech verb: this is direction of address, not possession or benefit. The angels are addressed by the question before the question asks whether they were treated as worship objects.

topics.headline: li as speech-recipient marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the small preposition fixes the angels as speech recipients before the charge tests whether they were worship objects.
topics.reason: The particle has broader possible values, but after the speech verb local syntax selects addressee-direction rather than possession, benefit, or agency.

words.gloss_range: definite governed angelic class addressed as respondents and later resumed as the alleged worship object
words.root_gloss_range: The root spans angelic agency, possession, dominion, and ownership language; here the angel noun selects delegated beings, not sovereign owners
words.prose: {{ar:لْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ}} ({{tr:l-malāʾikati}}) names a definite, known angelic class before the accusation focus appears, not vague unseen powers. The {{ar:م ل ك}} ({{tr:m-l-k}}) field keeps authority and ownership pressure nearby, but the local form names delegated angels, not sovereign owners; 21:26 makes the servant-status contrast sharp, and 34:42 later answers within the ownership field.

topics.headline: definite angel class under address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question addresses a known angelic class as respondents, not vague unseen powers.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, plural or collective, and genitive under the preceding preposition, making the angels governed addressees who are later resumed by the second-person object pronoun.

topics.headline: delegated agency contrasted with ownership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the angelic authority field is real but derivative, so the charge tests mistaking delegated agency for worship-worthy dominion.
topics.reason: The {{ar:م ل ك}} ({{tr:m-l-k}}) field includes angels, possession, and dominion, but the selected local noun names angels rather than owner or king forms; the authority pressure survives as delegation, not independent ownership.

topics.headline: angel servants inside ownership debate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that angel address sharpens the hierarchy: servants are questioned as alleged worship recipients while ownership is denied elsewhere.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete links: 21:26 calls angels honored servants, 34:22 and 34:42 constrain ownership or power, and 25:22 and 69:17 place angels in day-scenes.

words.gloss_range: interrogative proximal demonstrative presenting the gathered group as the subject of the quoted question
words.prose: {{ar:أَهَٰٓؤُلَآءِ}} ({{tr:ʾa-hāʾulāʾi}}) begins the quote by fusing question and display. The pointed group is grammatically the subject carried into the later auxiliary, and the order places these defendants before the addressed angels, making the accusation visible before the worship verb arrives.

topics.headline: question fused to display
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the quoted speech begins by asking and pointing at once.
topics.reason: The interrogative hamza is fused to the demonstrative, and attachment evidence marks the whole following clause as quoted divine question.

topics.headline: proximal display of the accused group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accused group is made present before the angels before their worship habit is named.
topics.reason: The demonstrative points to the gathered group and functions as the explicit subject later resumed by the plural auxiliary.

topics.headline: these-to-you confrontation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the courtroom relation before the verb: these people are displayed opposite the addressed angels.
topics.reason: The demonstrative precedes the fronted second-person object, so the utterance exposes one group while addressed to another.

words.gloss_range: independent second-person plural object pronoun fronted before the auxiliary to focus the alleged worship target
words.prose: {{ar:إِيَّاكُمْ}} ({{tr:ʾiyyākum}}) isolates the angels as the alleged object before the habit is even named: were they worshipping you precisely, or you alone? Its detached and fronted form makes the target the pressure point; the reader must carry that object across the auxiliary until the final worship verb resolves the dependency. The echo with 10:28 confirms a known partner-denial grammar, and the object-fronted worship formula is reused here as accusation rather than confession.

topics.headline: fronted detached object focus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question tests the alleged target of worship, not merely whether worship happened.
topics.reason: The independent object pronoun is fronted before the auxiliary and syntactically belongs to the final worship verb, creating focus and restriction on the worship target.

topics.headline: second-person plural resumes angels
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pronoun points to the addressed angelic class, not back to the gathered defendants.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence resolves the second-person plural object to the angel addressees, and the plural ending keeps the charge class-level.

topics.headline: formulaic object-fronting triangle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the staged triangle of displayed worshippers, addressed alleged recipients, and the worship action.
topics.reason: The construction parallels partner-denial grammar at 10:28 and recalls object-fronted worship formulae, but here the form is accusation rather than confession.

words.gloss_range: perfect plural auxiliary carrying the displayed group into a prior habitual state with the following imperfect predicate
words.root_gloss_range: The root ranges around being, existing, becoming, and state; here it functions as an auxiliary that locates a sustained past condition
words.prose: {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}) turns the accusation into prior habitual state, a condition the gathered scene can locate and put on record. After the fronted object, {{ar:ك و ن}} ({{tr:k-w-n}}) opens a predicate whose action is delayed to the end while the plural ending keeps the displayed group involved. The worldly past becomes present evidence in the gathered hearing, and 34:41 and 34:43 continue the same constructional field.

topics.headline: prior habitual state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the charge concerns an occupied pattern of worship, not one isolated completed rite.
topics.reason: The perfect auxiliary with the following imperfect predicate marks prior ongoing practice, and the {{ar:ك و ن}} ({{tr:k-w-n}}) state pressure keeps the habit as a condition brought into judgment.

topics.headline: auxiliary sustains object focus before closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the alleged object has already been displayed before the auxiliary opens the habitual predicate.
topics.reason: The auxiliary follows the fronted object and carries the demonstrative subject forward, delaying the charged action until the final verb.

topics.headline: habit grammar sets up answer sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this auxiliary-worship construction launches a sequence that the next verses clarify and deny.
topics.reason: The same construction recurs in 34:41 and 34:43, while 10:28 supplies a fronted-object partner-denial parallel.

words.gloss_range: active imperfect worship predicate after the auxiliary, with its object already fronted and its plural subject carried from the demonstrative
words.root_gloss_range: The root ranges around worship, service, obedience, servitude, and bondage; here Form I imperfect selects sustained worship-service allegiance
words.prose: {{ar:يَعْبُدُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿbudūn}}) resolves the long dependency: the object was fronted, the auxiliary opened past habit, and now the active plural verb names the charged worship. The {{ar:ع ب د}} ({{tr:ʿ-b-d}}) range makes the issue sustained allegiance, service, and a practiced path of submission, not a single rite or causative subjugation. The verse then stops with a heavy landing on this exposed habit, while 34:41 corrects the object and 21:26 sharpens the irony of servants being treated as worship recipients.

topics.headline: active durative worship with fronted object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the displayed group remains the active worshipping subject while the fronted object supplies the alleged target.
topics.reason: The imperfect predicate after the auxiliary is active, plural, and resolved by the previously fronted object, so the grammar exposes direction, agency, and persistence.

topics.headline: worship as sustained service allegiance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the charge is not bare ritual performance but a posture of service and submission directed to the wrong object.
topics.reason: The broader {{ar:ع ب د}} ({{tr:ʿ-b-d}}) field of worship, service, obedience, and bondage gives embodied pressure, while the local Form I imperfect keeps the selected act as direct worship-service, not causative subjugation.

topics.headline: worship object corrected in the answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse ends on a charge designed to be corrected by the next ayah and sharpened by the angels-servants contrast.
topics.reason: 34:41 preserves the same worship grammar while correcting the object, 21:26 defines angels as servants, 10:28 supplies a partner-denial parallel, and 34:39 to 34:43 forms a local {{ar:ع ب د}} ({{tr:ʿ-b-d}}) sequence.

topics.headline: final verb suspends the answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah closes on the exposed worship habit, forcing the angelic answer into the next verse.
topics.reason: The final predicate completes the quoted question and leaves resolution outside the verse, with the sound-row payoff kept as secondary support for the heavy landing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence يَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يَقُولُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A severe event drives a dispersed totality to one destination; only after exhaustive co-presence does uttered speech begin. The sequence therefore stages a hearing rather than an isolated question.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes a momentous occurring event and makes the temporal frame an ordeal, not a neutral date.
Driving and collecting a group toward a destination supplies compulsory assembly.
Wholeness without remainder makes the assembly evidentially exhaustive.
Audible utterance turns the assembled scene into a public examination.

changed_reading.before: God will gather people and ask angels a question.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages an exhaustive public hearing: compulsory co-presence precedes an audible test of the gathered people's alleged object of worship.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The address لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ and fronted object إِيَّاكُمْ in أَهَؤُلَاءِ إِيَّاكُمْ كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The deictic 'these' fixes the worshippers as present, while the fronted exclusive second-person object isolates the alleged recipient. Past كَانُوا with يَعْبُدُونَ presents an enduring practice whose attribution the addressed recipients must certify or reject.

activation_trace.role: The literal angel branch identifies the party compelled to answer the attribution.
Occurrence through time gives the alleged worship the character of an established past state.
Submissive worship supplies the relation whose true endpoint is under examination.

changed_reading.before: The question asks whether these people worshipped angels.
changed_reading.after: The question is an attribution audit: with worshippers and alleged recipients face-to-face, the recipients must certify whether the emphatically named 'you' was really the endpoint of a sustained allegiance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The single predication brings مَلَائِكَة and يَعْبُدُونَ into direct relation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The packet's ownership and sovereignty branches of م ل ك stand opposite the servitude and submissive-worship branches of ع ب د. Without claiming that 'angels' means owners, the branch collision lets the question probe whether devotion imaginatively installed the addressed creatures as masters.

activation_trace.role: Ownership and disposal supply the mastership pole activated around the named angels.
Sovereignty and rule sharpen the imagined authority being tested.
Owned servitude supplies the subordinate pole of the relation.
Submissive worship converts that hierarchy into devotional allegiance.

changed_reading.before: The verse identifies a mistaken cultic object.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it interrogates a manufactured master-servant relation: did human submission assign creaturely beings an ownership or sovereignty they did not possess?

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier jinn perform work under the Lord's permission and their ignorance of the unseen is exposed; later they are named as the beings worshipped. Against focus يَعْبُدُونَ, this produces a role reversal in which humans elevate limited, subordinate unseen workers into imagined masters.

activation_trace.role: Submissive worship anchors the hierarchy whose direction is being diagnosed.
The hidden jinn branch identifies the unseen creaturely class appearing as workers.
Intentional labor places that class in a service role.
Permission constrains their work under a higher authority.
What is screened from sight supplies the field of knowledge explicitly denied to them.
The same hidden-creature branch now names the operative object of worship.

structural_cues: 34:12 places jinn labor after بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِ, 34:14 denies their knowledge of the unseen, and 34:41 names jinn as worshipped.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies subordination, permission, epistemic limitation, and later worship; I infer the arrow from subordinate worker to imagined master as a diagnostic reversal. A live alternative is that the scenes concern different members of the class and merely contrast creaturely limits with human practice.

changed_reading.before: The focus asks which supernatural beings received worship.
changed_reading.after: It exposes an inverted service order: humans submitted to unseen creatures who themselves operate as permission-bound servants with limited knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Iblis's conjecture is realized through following despite his lack of coercive authority, while the angels later pair worship of jinn with settled belief in them. Worship in the focus thus expands from ritual address to enacted, credulous allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Obedient submission anchors worship as a lived relation rather than a label alone.
Supposition supplies the projected expectation that human conduct goes on to realize.
Loyal succession supplies the behavioral mechanism by which the projection becomes effective.
The negated capacity and authority rule out coercion as the mechanism.
Hidden jinn identify the allegiance's operative supernatural object.
Heart-settled assent supplies the inner uptake paired with worship.

structural_cues: 34:20-21 sequences conjecture, following, and absence of authority; 34:41 sequences worship of jinn and belief in them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following without coercive authority and later joins worship to belief; I infer that willing allegiance is the shared causal mechanism. Overt cultic acts remain a live alternative or additional expression, not something the model excludes.

changed_reading.before: يَعْبُدُونَ denotes a direct ritual act aimed at angels.
changed_reading.after: يَعْبُدُونَ can diagnose a wider allegiance enacted by following and stabilized by belief, even where the followed power had no coercive authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The claimed beings are called, then stripped of ownership, partnership, support, autonomous intercession, benefit, and harm. Addressing the angels in the focus therefore audits the capacities that worshippers projected onto them rather than presuming those capacities.

activation_trace.role: The literal angels are the alleged powerful recipients placed under examination.
Submissive worship anchors the projected dependency being tested.
Calling and verbal inclination enact the test of the alleged beings.
An assertion without certainty marks their status as projected rather than established.
Negated ownership removes independent disposal of even the smallest thing.
Negated participation removes any shared stake in cosmic control.
The joining of an intercessor to another supplies the hoped-for mediation.
Required permission removes autonomy from that mediation.
Negated benefit removes the positive outcome expected from the alleged relation.
Negated harm removes its feared coercive counterpart.

structural_cues: 34:22 denies atom-weight ownership and partnership, 34:23 restricts intercession to permission, and 34:42 denies mutual benefit and harm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a serial removal of capacities surrounding claimed beings; I infer that the focus interrogation is the personal evidentiary form of that same audit. The alternative is a looser thematic recurrence rather than a deliberately staged capacity test.

changed_reading.before: The angels are asked whether they were worshipped.
changed_reading.after: The angels are called as witnesses so every projected basis for worship, including ownership, partnership, mediation, benefit, and harm, can be denied by the alleged recipients themselves.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier promise that the Lord will gather the two sides and then open between them in truth supplies a procedural template. In the focus, حشر plus جميعًا establishes the court, and ثم يقول begins a particular evidentiary opening.

activation_trace.role: Compulsory movement to a common destination convenes the parties.
Uttered speech supplies the first explicit examination after convening.
Joining separated parties supplies the earlier procedural gathering.
Opening an enclosure by judgment supplies decisive adjudication between the gathered sides.

structural_cues: 34:26 has يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا ... ثُمَّ يَفْتَحُ بَيْنَنَا بِالْحَقِّ; 34:40 repeats gathering followed by ثُمَّ and speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated gather-then-act sequence and explicitly judicial فتح; I infer that the earlier sequence functions as a procedural template for the focus. A live alternative is that both are independent depictions of final judgment without a narrower courtroom correspondence.

changed_reading.before: The gathering is merely logistical preparation for a question.
changed_reading.after: The gathering is itself the opening of adjudication, and the question to the angels is a first case-specific act of separating truth from projected association.

context_deltas.mechanism: The stopped weak and great return speech and blame to one another; the weak identify repeated commands to disbelieve and install rivals. The focus then adds the alleged supernatural recipients as witnesses, widening a two-party blame exchange into a three-party examination of how worship was socially produced.

activation_trace.role: The divine utterance redirects the preceding exchanges into controlled examination.
Submissive obedience is the relation whose social production is investigated.
Stopping a person upon knowledge supplies the compelled examination posture.
Returning an answer or speech supplies the reciprocal blame mechanism.
Lack of power identifies the subordinated human party claiming influence by the great.
Demand backed by obligation supplies the social pressure named by the weak.
A counterpart set as a rival supplies the manufactured object that the commands promote.

structural_cues: 34:31-33 repeatedly alternates speech between weak and great, then names command as the mechanism for making rivals; 34:40 changes the addressee to the alleged recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stopped parties, returned speech, hierarchy, commands, and installed rivals; I infer that questioning the angels prevents the human blame exchange from settling the object's identity by itself. The alternative is that the focus begins a separate scene with no procedural extension of the leader-follower dispute.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks about an individual's mistaken devotion.
changed_reading.after: It examines a socially manufactured allegiance: after leaders and followers dispute causation, the alleged recipients themselves are called to test the object that command and imitation had installed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The angels clear God of the attribution, affirm that He rather than the humans is their protecting authority, and redirect the operative allegiance to hidden jinn trusted by the worshippers. The emphatic إِيَّاكُمْ therefore tests a named object precisely so nominal address and actual endpoint can be disaggregated.

activation_trace.role: The literal angels are the named recipients whose testimony can reject the attribution.
Submissive worship anchors the relation whose endpoint is being resolved.
Exonerating transcendence opens the angels' rejection of the alleged relation.
Undertaking and governing an affair identifies God as the angels' actual authority.
Otherness marks the humans as excluded from that protective relation.
Hidden jinn supply the operative endpoint named in place of the angels.
Settled assent explains how that hidden endpoint was inwardly ratified.

structural_cues: The answer in 34:41 moves from exoneration, to the angels' own allegiance, to denial of human clientship, and finally to jinn and belief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet directly supplies the denial and redirection; I infer a distinction between the named heavenly object and the hidden operative endpoint of allegiance. A live alternative is simpler: the angel attribution was merely false and jinn were directly worshipped, without any proxy or misregistration mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The question seeks a yes-or-no identification of angel worship.
changed_reading.after: The question deliberately names the alleged heavenly recipient so its own testimony can separate nominal object from operative allegiance: angels deny clientship and redirect the relation to hidden jinn.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus compels everyone into one scene, but the sequel denies mutual disposal, benefit, and harm, then depicts failed reach and a barrier before what is desired. Gathering all is therefore not relational reunion; it is maximal co-presence combined with terminated access.

activation_trace.role: Driving everyone to one destination supplies unavoidable co-presence.
Totality without remainder ensures that no party is absent.
Negated disposal severs agency between parties despite their shared scene.
Negated benefit blocks the hoped-for positive transfer.
Negated harm completes the loss of reciprocal power.
Failure of escape or attainment closes the possibility of evading the scene.
Reaching by extension supplies the access now declared unavailable.
An intervening barrier supplies final separation from the desired relation.

structural_cues: 34:42 immediately follows the angel exchange with no mutual benefit or harm; 34:51-54 closes the surah with capture, failed reach, and an intervening barrier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies total gathering followed by repeated failures of capacity and reach; I infer that proximity is judicial while access is relationally severed. The alternative is that the later spatial images concern punishment generally and do not qualify the semantics of gathering.

changed_reading.before: Gathering all parties together implies reunion or restored connection.
changed_reading.after: The focus creates coercive co-presence for testimony while simultaneously preparing the disclosure that the gathered parties have no usable access, transfer, or protective relation between them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads a later pair-and-single instruction back into جَمِيعًا; it remains valid as a sequence-level activation anchored in the focus branch of recomposing dispersed parts. Downstream prose should call it a compositional echo, not a grammatical equation or claim that the two scenes are identical.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جَمِيعًا as complete recomposition of what had been separable.

activation_trace.role: Joining dispersed parts anchors the later reassembly of differentiated persons.
Joining one to one supplies pairwise disaggregation of the crowd.
The solitary individual preserves irreducible personal accountability.
The heart's repeated consideration explains why pair and individual separation matters before total public reckoning.

changed_reading.before: جَمِيعًا flattens everyone into an undifferentiated mass.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the total hearing recomposes persons who can also be isolated in pairs and singly: no one disappears into the crowd, yet every relation is present for public testing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the regional agrarian sense of ح ش ر rather than the dominant human-gathering sense. It remains anchored because the packet explicitly supplies that focus-root branch and an earlier garden-to-replacement-produce sequence; downstream prose must label it a material analogy, never a translation of يَحْشُرُ or a historical claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَحْشُرُ through the supplied branch of crop residue remaining after harvest.

activation_trace.role: The post-harvest residue branch supplies an image of what remains exposed after a cultivated order is stripped.
The tree-covered garden supplies the prior cultivated enclosure.
One thing standing in place of another supplies the stripping and replacement event.
The yield of tree and crop supplies the material whose altered remainder can be inspected.

changed_reading.before: The final gathering is only the transport of persons into one place.
changed_reading.after: As a contained agrarian analogy, the assembly also resembles after-harvest exposure: once protective abundance and substitutions are gone, the residue of allegiance is collected and inspected.

strongest_changes: The scene shifted from a generic eschatological question to an exhaustive judicial attribution hearing.
Worship shifted from presumed direct angel-cult to a belief-driven and behaviorally followed allegiance whose named and operative objects can diverge.
The creatures' lack of ownership, authorization, benefit, and harm became the point of addressing them as witnesses.
Universal gathering became compulsory co-presence without restored access or protection.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah cues linked the focus roots to judicial opening, permission-limited unseen workers, leader-follower speech, and the angels' own denial; distant agrarian and pair-individual branches also yielded contained secondary models.
remaining_uncertainties: It remains uncertain whether the following of Iblis in 34:20-21 is the same mechanism as belief in jinn in 34:41 or only an analogous pattern.
The ownership and sovereignty activation around مَلَائِكَة may be rhetorically live through the packet's م ل ك inventory without being an intended lexical sense of the noun.
The harvest and pair-individual readings remain structural or material analogies, not grammatical senses of the focus wording.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Gathering converts diffuse worship into a face-to-face audit.** `ح ش ر/B001` is gathering while driving to a destination, `ج م ع/B009` wholeness without loss, `م ل ك/B001` strength and cohesion, and `ع ب د/B003` submissive worship. The event gathers everyone wholly, then directly questions the beings around whom worship claims cohered. Driving supplies compulsory convergence; wholeness prevents missing parties; the question tests the worship relation in the presence of its alleged object. The packet gives gathering and address; I infer that presence dissolves the distance on which misattribution depended. The ayah reads resurrection as relational verification.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:41’s disavowal and 34:42’s disabled transfer channels completed the audit: gathering does not merely assemble bodies but exposes and dissolves false relational claims.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Gathering as consolidation for a worship audit.** `ح ش ر B001` supplies gathering and driving a group to a destination, `ج م ع B009` wholeness without scattering, and `ع ب د B003` worship and submissive obedience. The boast in numbers at 34:35 is answered by one complete assembly, followed by a direct question to the alleged objects; 34:42 will deny every gathered party power over benefit or harm. The branches assign gathering the consolidation role and questioning the audit role. The packet supplies assembly and inquiry; I infer that dispersion is removed so claimed relations can be tested face to face. The gathering reads as an accountability operation, not crowd imagery alone.

2. **Alleged heavenly ownership put on the record.** `م ل ك B002` supplies ownership and disposal, while the surface `ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ` anchors the root in the questioned party. Nearby 34:39 names the true provider, and 34:42 denies creatures any disposal of benefit or harm. The branch gives the question an ownership dimension: did worship correspond to any actual power held by its recipients? The packet supplies the provider claim and later negation; I infer that the question exposes a title without disposal. The scene reads as an audit of projected authority.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:42 stated the audit result in the same ownership vocabulary: no part owns benefit or harm for another. 34:45's comparison with materially stronger predecessors then confirmed that gathered scale supplies no exemption.

baseline.text: O gün onların hepsini toplayacak, sonra meleklere, ‘Bunlar size mi tapıyordu?’ diyecek.

findings.text: Eksiksiz toplama, dağınık ibadet ilişkilerini iddia edilen nesneleriyle yüz yüze getirerek dirilişi ilişkisel bir doğrulama ve hesap işlemi haline getirir.
Meleklere yöneltilen soru, onlara yakıştırılan göksel unvanın gerçek bir mülkiyet ve sonuçlar üzerinde tasarruf taşıyıp taşımadığını da sınar.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It closely parallels the complete gathering and questioning of idolaters about their alleged partners.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It concerns fear redirected from Satan's allies, not worship's judgment-day verification.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It affirms that death and killing end in return to God for the focus's gathering scene.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It repeats the complete gathering of associators and partners, whose claimed worship is then denied.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The immediate reply identifies God as the angels' protector and redirects the worship to jinn.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Divine dominion and witness are only a broad foundation for the coming inquiry.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It directly gathers worshippers with their objects and asks whether they misled God's servants.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It tests worship through the alleged object's inability to control harm or benefit.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It names angels as God's servants and joins refusal of worship with universal gathering to Him.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It records the angels' obedience to Adam without the focus's false-worship accountability.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The human-jinn coalition concerns the Qur'an's inimitability, not worship or final questioning.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It refutes deifying Christ through God's exclusive power over all created beings.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It commands the gathering of wrongdoers together with those they used to worship.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: God questions Jesus about a false deification claim, closely matching the focus's interrogative judgment scene.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its marital justice ruling does not clarify the focus relation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It gathers jinn and humans and exposes their reciprocal alliance before judgment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its rejection of compelled belief only indirectly concerns accountable human worship.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Cosmic joining of sun and moon is only a distant gathering parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It depicts the day of gathering as a face-to-face reckoning for deniers of meeting God.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It states that jinn and humans were created for worship, supplying the proper relation judged in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It exposes a worshipped calf as unable to answer or control harm and benefit.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The imagined ransom of all people concerns punishment, not false worship.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Jesus denies commanding worship of himself and defers final witness to God.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The return of all affairs to God gives only a general judgment horizon.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Claimed partners are summoned on the Day but cannot answer their worshippers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It tests a sonship claim through worship, without the focus's gathering or accountability scene.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It directly states humanity's eventual gathering to God.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Those liable for punishment repudiate being worshipped, directly echoing the angels' expected answer.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It declares the Lord transcendent above the false descriptions underlying angel worship.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Moses distinguishes his authority from a rebellious people; it is unrelated to alleged worship.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It only introduces God's address to the angels about Adam's creation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Disbelief in God is relevant generally but lacks the focus's relational judgment scene.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Noah's warning establishes exclusive worship of God before the day of punishment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly grounds universal gathering in God's wisdom and knowledge.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The description of a high garden does not clarify the focus relation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It contrasts withdrawal from false objects of worship with worship of God alone.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It only introduces God's address to angels about human creation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It commands believers to worship God alone despite changing location.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The wrongdoer's regret over abandoning the messenger is not about worshipped intermediaries.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It joins worshippers with what they worship, though outside the focus's courtroom inquiry.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: It concerns failed oaths and deeds, not worship or final gathering.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It denies independent intercessory power to those invoked besides God.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The angels' prostration narrative does not address their alleged worship by humans.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It states that all will be assembled at an appointed Day.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It repeats the angels' prostration to Adam without the focus's accountability relation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Pharaoh's mobilization of gatherers is unrelated to divine judgment or worship.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: A testing question about who received grace only faintly resembles the focus's question form.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Universal disbelief does not affect God, but it does not examine alleged worship.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It links universal return to God with resurrection and just recompense.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It challenges alleged intercessors as powerless and uncomprehending.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: It concerns the admission of people to Paradise after an earlier dispute.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It describes the Hereafter as a witnessed Day for which all people are gathered.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly denies that a prophet could command people to worship him besides God.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It rejects claimed mediators because they cannot remove or redirect harm.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It frames the legitimacy of worship through testimony that no gods besides God were authorized.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The people's excuse for the calf affair does not develop the final inquiry into whom they worshipped.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The nearby contrast between guidance and manifest error only broadly frames the focus's polemic.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The rescue of Moses and his followers is unrelated to worship or accountability.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Regret for failing to prepare for life gives only a broad judgment-day parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The gathering of wild beasts is a distant lexical parallel only.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: A question about belief in resurrection does not clarify worship or its objects.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its closing reminder of gathering is incidental to a pilgrimage food ruling.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: On the Day God asks directly for the alleged partners people used to claim.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It limits intercession to one holding a covenant with the Merciful.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It repeats the Day-of-judgment question about claimed partners.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Abraham commands worship of God and piety as the proper alternative to false devotion.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's question to angels tests knowledge, not whether humans worshipped them.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It gathers criminals on the Day, supplying the judgment setting without the worship inquiry.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It announces punishment for deeds without identifying false worship or its objects.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The nearby verse strips alleged partners of ownership, partnership, and supporting power.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It fixes resurrection as the horizon after death but does not develop worship accountability.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The description of a divinely taught servant does not clarify the focus relation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The challenge to a collective plot is unrelated to false worship's final verification.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Provision and divine knowledge do not clarify the focus relation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The condemned are asked where the beings they used to worship now are.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Abraham and his followers dissociate themselves from all worship besides God.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: A public assembly for Moses' contest is only a lexical gathering parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's witness separates worshippers from alleged objects that deny knowing of their worship.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Criminals' false oath about earthly duration is only a broad resurrection-scene parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The complete gathering of Iblis's forces helps identify the concealed allegiance exposed by the angels.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: This introductory statement does not clarify the focus relation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The immediate consequence denies all mutual power of harm or benefit and judges the wrongdoers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Universal questioning about deeds is related only at the broadest accountability level.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: It concerns human miserliness if entrusted with divine mercy stores.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Even angels and a complete confrontation would not compel belief; it lacks the focus's worship inquiry.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The mention of God's mercy to Zachariah does not clarify the focus relation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: God gathers the messengers and questions them about their communities' response.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its reminder that all will be gathered to God is incidental to pilgrimage observance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It assigns all intercession and dominion to God before the universal return to Him.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Noah's status as a believing servant does not clarify the focus relation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: At judgment the associators deny their association, exposing the falsity at issue in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The failed ransom on the Day of Resurrection is only a general judgment parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It links following devils with harmful teaching, but not the focus's gathering and inquiry.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The qualities of believers do not clarify the focus's false-worship accountability.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Return to the Knower of the unseen and seen entails disclosure of people's deeds.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Solomon's ordered army of jinn, humans, and birds is not a judgment or worship scene.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Recompense for evil deeds is only a broad accountability parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly describes the rapid resurrection gathering as easy for God.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It distinguishes believers and disbelievers around Jesus' call, not alleged worship of heavenly beings.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It sharply separates incompatible objects of worship, without the focus's final interrogation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly rejects taking angels and prophets as lords, directly addressing the false elevation tested in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It identifies the alleged female divinities with invocation of a rebellious Satan, closely illuminating the angels' redirection to jinn worship.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: At return to God, claimed intercessors and partners are absent, exposing the broken association.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It states that people made jinn partners for God, supplying the concealed allegiance disclosed in 34:41.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: At death the angels ask where those invoked besides God are, directly anticipating the failure of alleged objects of worship.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Those invoked besides God are themselves servants, undermining their treatment as objects of worship.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It names worship of powerless beings and the claim that they intercede with God.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Every soul is tested for what it sent ahead, while its fabricated claims vanish before God.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It rejects invented divine names and commands worship of God alone.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Those invoked besides God cannot answer, exposing the futility of their claimed religious relation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Those invoked besides God create nothing and are themselves created, denying them divinity.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Associators identify their alleged partners, who answer by declaring the claimants liars.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: When peril comes, all beings invoked besides God disappear from the worshippers' appeal.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It states that people took gods besides God seeking honor from them.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Those alleged gods will deny their worship and turn against their worshippers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The calf worshippers persist in devotion to it despite its exposed inability to respond.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Worshippers and the beings they worship besides God are jointly assigned to Hell.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It condemns worship without revealed authority or knowledge.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It demonstrates that those invoked besides God lack even the power to create or recover a fly.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Calling on another god without proof leads to an account before the Lord.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: False gods possess neither creation nor control over harm, benefit, death, or resurrection.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The worshipped beings deny choosing protectors besides God and explain the worshippers' self-forgetfulness.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It criticizes worship of beings that neither benefit nor harm.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Abraham's question, 'What do you worship?', directly examines the object of devotion.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Claimed partners are summoned but cannot answer when their worshippers confront punishment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The associators find no intercessors among their partners and disavow those partnerships.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It challenges whether any alleged partner shares God's acts of creation, provision, death, and life.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Those invoked besides God cannot hear or answer and will deny the worshippers' association on Resurrection Day.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's covenant forbids worshipping Satan, identifying the underlying allegiance redirected to jinn in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Alleged gods are taken for help but cannot actually help their worshippers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The gathered wrongdoers are explicitly joined to the beings they worshipped besides God.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It records worship of protectors for supposed nearness to God and assigns their dispute to divine judgment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It challenges why people call on powerless beings besides the sole Creator.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It rejects any command to worship other than God.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It contrasts disbelief when God alone is called upon with belief when partners are associated with Him.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It exposes the false attribution made about the angels, who are servants of the Merciful.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly records the claim that the angels were worshipped under the Merciful's will.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It demands evidence that alleged partners created anything or hold any share in creation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It denies that even angels' intercession has effect without God's permission.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It links denial of the Hereafter to falsely naming the angels as females.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It condemns the conjecture that supports the false claims about angels.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It identifies human refuge-seeking from jinn, a related concealed allegiance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It commands that no one be invoked alongside God.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The messenger denies possessing independent harm or guidance, reinforcing the rejection of claimed intermediaries.

These generated outputs may inform channel-family/path context when the agent has file access, but first-pass review limits still apply: no established channel name, accept/reject claim, or maturity claim unless a future adjudicated ledger is present.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bilinen günü güneşin doğuşundan batışına kadar süren zaman olarak tanımlar ve onu günler dizisinin tek bir birimi sayar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu iki kurucu özelliği de doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnızca sınırları gün doğumu ve gün batımıyla belirlenen gündüz süresini kapsar; belirsiz süre, devir ve olay anlamları ayrı dallardadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın kullanımı tanımlar; günlük işlem bildiren türemiş kullanım, temel gün anlamının yerine geçirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Güneşin doğuşundan batışına kadar uzanan bilinen zaman aralığı ve bu aralıklardan oluşan dizinin tek bir birimidir.

facets.statement: Başlangıcı güneşin doğuşu, sonu güneşin batışıdır; aynı zamanda sayılabilen günlerden biridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bilinen günün güneşin doğuşuyla başlayıp batışıyla bittiği ve çoğulu bulunan sayılabilir bir zaman birimi olduğu konusunda birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Günün geceyi dışarıda bırakan, doğal ışık sınırlarıyla belirlenmiş tek bir zaman birimi olarak kastedildiği kullanımlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hem gün doğumu ile gün batımı arasındaki sınırı hem de tek bir gün birimi olmayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Karşıtlığın geceyle kurulduğu ve sayılabilir birim özelliğinin bağlamdan zaten anlaşıldığı cümlelerde doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Güneşin doğuşu ile batışı arasındaki aydınlık zaman aralığını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hem doğal gündüz sınırının hem de bunun tek bir sayılabilir birim olduğunun açıkça belirtilmesi gereken bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sınırlandırılmış gündüz süresini ve onun tek bir gün birimi oluşunu birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: gün gün veya gündelik esasa göre yapılan işlem

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Gün doğumunu kesin başlangıç sayar ve aralığı sayılabilir tek bir gün birimi olarak kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Gündüz ışığını ve şafaktan gün batımına uzanan süreyi kapsar; ayrıca gündüzle ilişkili başka kullanımları da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de gecenin karşısındaki aydınlık zaman kesitini gün batımına kadar anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal, başlangıcı güneşin doğuşu olan sayılabilir günü tanımlar. Komşu dal ise şafaktan başlayan gündüzü ve onun ışığını öne çıkarır; bu yüzden sınırları tam örtüşmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Süreyi gün doğumu ile gün batımı arasında kesin olarak sınırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Her uzunluktaki bir zaman dilimini ve bazı bağlamlarda bir devri anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir zaman kesitini gün sözü üzerinden kavramlaştırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal doğal göksel sınırları olan bilinen gündür; komşu dalın süresi belirlenmemiştir ve devir kadar genişleyebilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Olayın niteliğinden bağımsız, gerçek bir gündüz zaman aralığını belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Büyük veya çetin bir olayı, onun yaşandığı kritik günü ya da çoğulda olayları belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Olay dalındaki kullanımlar, bir gün içinde yaşananlardan hareketle bu zaman birimiyle ilişki kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın çekirdeği zamansal sınırdır. Komşu dalda gün, olayın büyüklüğünü veya çetinliğini taşıyan mecazî ve bağlama bağlı bir anlatıma dönüşür.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yalnızca gündüz sınırı, belirsiz süre ve olay günüyle doğrudan karışabilecek üç komşu yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: اليوم المعروف: وقت من طلوع الشمس إلى غروبها، وهو الواحد من الأيام وجمعه أيام.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس المراد هنا مطلق الدهر، ولا الوقائع والنعم، ولا تركيب يومئذ.
branches.source_phrase_ar: اليوم: الواحد من الأيام (maqayis)؛ اليوم مقداره من طلوع الشمس إلى غروبها (ayn;tahdhib)؛ اليوم معروف والجمع أيام (sihah)؛ اليوم يعبر به عن وقت طلوع الشمس إلى غروبها (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözü herhangi bir uzunluktaki zaman süresi için genişletir ve bazı kullanımlarda devir anlamına geldiğini açıkça belirtir. Dal çerçevesi, sınırlı gündüz anlamından bu geniş zamansal kullanıma geçişi doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal, uzunluğu önceden belirlenmeyen süreyi ve bağlama bağlı devir anlamını kapsar; belirli gündüz aralığını veya olayın kendisini tanımlamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimin belirsiz süre ve devir kullanımı, iki karşıt hayat durumunu anlatan özel söz öbeğinden ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Uzunluğu önceden sınırlandırılmamış bir zaman dilimidir; bazı bağlamlarda kişinin veya bir şeyin devri kadar geniş bir süreyi anlatır.

facets.statement: Herhangi bir uzunluktaki zaman süresini belirtir ve bilinen gündüz sınırlarına bağlı değildir.
Bağlama göre uzun bir devir veya bir varlığın yaşadığı dönemler anlamına genişleyebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu kullanımda gün sözünün sabit gündüz süresinden çıkarak herhangi bir zaman dilimini, özel bağlamlarda ise bir devri anlatabildiğini gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Hem süre uzunluğunun serbestliğini hem de bağlama bağlı devir genişlemesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sürenin sınırlarının önem taşımadığı ve yalnızca belirsiz bir zaman kesitinin anlatıldığı cümlelerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Uzunluğu belirtilmemiş bir zaman dilimi olma özelliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlam sözün tek bir günü değil, uzun bir hayat veya tarih dönemini anlattığını gösterdiğinde uygundur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyük olay, olayın gerçekleşmesi, şiddetli gün ve çoğulda yaşanmış olaylar kullanımlarını aynı dalda toplar. Bu çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak bunların tek bir yalın anlam değil, gün ile olay arasındaki aktarmaya dayanan bağlı kullanımlar olduğu açıkça belirtilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, büyük veya çetin olayla bağlantılı mecazî ve kalıplaşmış kullanımlarla sınırlıdır; literal zaman süresi ve yalnızca Tanrı'ya bağlanan anma günleri dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Olayı anlatan biçimsel genişleme, şiddetli gün bildiren kalıplar ve çoğul olay anlamı ayrı yüzler olarak korunur; kalıp anlamları yalın kullanıma genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Büyük veya çetin bir olayın gerçekleştiği kritik günü ya da olayın kendisini anlatan aktarmalı kullanımdır. Bazı kalıplarda çok ağır bir gün, çoğul biçimde ise yaşanmış önemli olaylar anlamı taşır.

facets.statement: Gün sözü, büyük bir olay gerçekleştiğinde o kritik zamanı veya gerçekleşen olayı anlatmak üzere aktarılır.
Belirli kalıplarda günün çok çetin, ağır ve etkisi uzun süren bir gün olduğu vurgulanır.
Çoğul biçim, bilinen günlerde gerçekleşmiş önemli olayları veya tarihî vakaları anlatabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gün sözünün büyük bir olayın gerçekleşmesine aktarılmasını, çetin gün anlatımında kullanılmasını ve çoğul biçimin olayları belirtmesini aynı anlamsal aile içinde verir.

error_profile.preserves: Kritik zaman ile olay arasındaki aktarmayı ve çetinlik boyutunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Büyük bir olayın meydana geldiği zamanın, olayla özdeşleşmiş bir dönüm noktası olarak anlatıldığı cümlelerde kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, Tanrı'ya bağlanan günleri insanlara hatırlatılan nimet, bağışlama, ceza ve toplumsal olaylarla açıklar; bu bağlamanın günlere özel değer kazandırdığını da belirtir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu sınırlı ifadeyi doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca Tanrı'ya bağlanarak nimet, bağışlama, ceza veya ibret verici olayla anılan günleri kapsar; her önemli ya da çetin gün buraya girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca Tanrı'ya bağlanan günler ifadesine aittir; nimet, ceza ve anma içeriği yalın gün sözüne genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Tanrı'nın nimet, bağışlama veya cezalandırma gibi unutulmaması gereken etkileriyle anılan günlerdir. Bu bağlama, söz konusu günlerin önemini ve hatırlatıcı değerini yükseltir.

facets.statement: Günler, Tanrı'nın insanlara yönelik etkili ve hatırlanmaya değer işleriyle ilişkilendirilir.
Anılan işler nimet verme ve bağışlamanın yanı sıra bir topluluğa inen cezayı da kapsayabilir.
Günlerin Tanrı'ya bağlanması, o günlerde verilen nimetler ve gerçekleşen işler nedeniyle onlara özel değer kazandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, Tanrı'ya bağlanan günlerin nimetleri ve önemli işleri hatırlattığını; bu işlerin bağışlama kadar cezayı da içerebildiğini ve bağlamanın günleri yücelttiğini gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir topluluğu yalnızca bir arada bulunmuş saymaktan öte, onu bulunduğu yerden çıkarıp belirli bir hedefe doğru sürerek toplamayı açıkça bildirir. Büyük son toplanma, toplanma yeri ve insanları önden götüren kişi de bu işlemin ad, yer ve yapan kişi uzantılarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal tek bir kişinin hareketini ya da küçük kara hayvanlarını değil, bir topluluğun yönlendirilerek bir araya getirilmesini kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın toplama ve sevk etme çekirdeğini korurken gün, yer, yapan kişi ve savaşa çıkarma gibi kalıba bağlı kullanımları ayrı yüzler olarak gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğu bulunduğu yerden çıkarıp belirli bir hedefe doğru sevk ederek bir araya getirmektir. Bütün insanların son kez toplanması, toplanılan yer ve insanları toplayıp önden götüren kişi bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Birden çok kişiyi bulundukları yerden çıkararak aynı hedefe doğru sevk edip toplama.
Bütün insanların yeniden dirilişle birlikte son bir buluşma yerine toplanması ve bu toplanmanın günü ya da yeri.
İnsanları toplayan, sevk eden veya onların önünde toplanma yerine doğru ilerleyen kişi.
Bir topluluğu savaş gibi belirli bir amaç için yerinden çıkarma; olumsuz kalıpta savaşa çıkarmama.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, çekirdeği topluluğun bir hedefe doğru sevk edilerek bir araya getirilmesi olarak ortaklaşa verir. Son büyük toplanma, buluşma yeri ve toplayıp önden götüren kişi bu işlem çevresinde adlaşan kullanımlardır. Olumsuz kalıpta kadınların savaşa çıkarılmaması da tanıklanan dar bir kullanımdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Topluluğun hem bir araya getirilmesini hem de belirli bir hedefe doğru yöneltilmesini birlikte anlatan çekirdek karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluk, sevk etme, hedef ve bir araya getirme bileşenlerinin tümünü korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki kalıba bağlı sonucu açıkça birleştirir: çetin yıl insanlara zarar verip onları çevreden kentlere indirir, malı ise giderir ya da yok eder. Bu, genel toplama eylemi değil, yılın özne olduğu özel bir anlatımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca çetin yılın insanları yerinden sürmesi veya malı tüketmesi kalıplarında geçerlidir; yalın kök anlamına genellenemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım bütünüyle iki tanıklı kalıba bağlıdır: çetin yıl insanları kentlere sürer veya malı tüketir; bağımsız bir yalın anlam kurulmaz.

concept_map.definition: Çetin bir yılın insanlara ağır zarar vererek onları çevreden kentlere sürmesi ya da bir ailenin malını tüketip ortadan kaldırmasıdır. İki sonuç yalnızca yılın etkin özne olduğu kalıplara bağlıdır.

Çetin yılın bir kişinin ya da ailenin malını tüketmesi, yok etmesi veya elinden gidermesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, ağır kıtlık yılını insanları kentlere süren ve malı tüketen etkin bir güç gibi kurar. İnsanlar bakımından zarar ve zorunlu yer değiştirme, mal bakımından ise tükenme sonucu öne çıkar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli hayvanların bu eylemini ölüm olarak açıklar, ancak anlatımı bir görüş veya aktarım olarak sınırlar. Bu nedenle ölüm okuması korunur fakat kökün genel ve bağımsız anlamı gibi sunulamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ölüm anlamı yalnızca tanıklanan hayvan bağlamına ve aktarılan yoruma aittir; genel toplama dalının yerine geçmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, belirli hayvanları konu alan tanıklı söz öbeğiyle sınırlıdır ve yalın biçime genel bir ölüm anlamı yüklemez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli hayvanlardan söz eden tanıklı kullanımda, onların ölmesi demektir. Kaynakların aktarım kaydıyla verdiği bu okuma genel bir toplama veya genel bir ölüm fiili değildir.

facets.statement: Belirli hayvanların söz konusu edildiği kalıpta eylemin onların ölümü diye yorumlanması.
Okumanın kesin ve genel bir tanım olarak değil, aktarılan bir görüş veya rivayet olarak kaydedilmesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar hayvanlara bağlı bu kullanımı ölüm diye açıklar; bunlardan biri açıklamayı açıkça aktarılmış bir görüş olarak sunar. Dolayısıyla tanıklık vardır, fakat genel anlam düzeyine çıkarılmamalıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tekil ve çoğul biçimleri, karada yaşayan küçük hayvanlar için geniş bir eski sınıf adı olarak tanımlar ve küçük kemirgenler, kirpiler ile kertenkele benzeri hayvanları örnekler. Bu yüzden dal modern böcek sınıfına indirgenmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kapsam, yalnız böcekleri değil, kaynakların küçük kara hayvanı saydığı farklı türleri içerir; topluluğu sevk etme anlamıyla ilgisizdir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım tekil ve çoğul yalın adları kapsar; kara ile kurulan kalıp aynı sınıfın ortamını belirginleştirir, yeni bir genel kök anlamı oluşturmaz.

concept_map.definition: Karada yaşayan küçük hayvanlar için kullanılan geniş bir eski sınıf adıdır. Küçük kemirgenler, kirpiler ve kertenkele benzerleri örnek verildiğinden, kapsam günümüz Türkçesindeki böcek sınıfından daha geniştir.

facets.statement: Karada yaşayan çeşitli küçük hayvanları tek bir geniş ad altında toplama.
Küçük kemirgenler, kirpiler ve kertenkele benzeri hayvanların bu sınıfa örnek gösterilmesi.
Kara ile kurulan söz öbeğinde sınıfın yerde ve karada yaşayan küçük hayvanlar olarak belirginleşmesi.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الحشرة والحشرات بمعنى صغار دواب الأرض وما يشبهها كاليرابيع والضباب والقنافذ ونحوها، وما جعله بعضهم اسما جامعا.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, aynı betimleyici biçimleri hayvanlarda sıkı ve toplu beden yapısı, erkeklerde ise iri karın, iri gövde veya şişkin yanlar için kullanır. Bunlar tek bir zorunlu özellik kümesi değil, yoğun ve iri beden görünümü çevresindeki tanıklı değişkelerdir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal küçük kara hayvanı adını ya da incelik-sivrilik niteliğini değil, bedenin sıkı, iri veya kabarık görünümünü anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın betimleyici biçimler sıkı yapı ve iri karın değişkelerini taşır; belirli beden bölümleriyle kurulan kalıp yalnız kendi açık kapsamıyla korunur.

concept_map.definition: İnsan veya hayvan bedeninin sıkı, toplu ve güçlü yapılı olması ya da karın ve yanların iri, dolgun veya kabarık görünmesidir. Kaynaklardaki betimlemeler bağlama göre bu özelliklerden birini öne çıkarır.

facets.statement: Hayvanın veya insanın sıkı, toplu ve güçlü bir beden yapısına sahip olması.
Erkekte karnın ya da bütün gövdenin iri olması.
Özellikle atta yanların dolgun, kabarık veya dışa taşkın görünmesi.
Belirli bir erkek kişi için cinsel organın ve karnın iri olduğunu bildiren beden bölümü kalıbı.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sıkı ve toplu beden yapısı ile iri karın betimlemelerini ortak alan olarak verir; bazı anlatımlar iri gövdeyi, bazıları şişkin yanları öne çıkarır. Beden bölümlerine bağlı daha dar kullanım da aynı yoğunluk ve irilik görünümüne bağlanır.

concept_gloss.text: sıkı yapılılık ya da iri karınlılık
concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan ve hayvan betimlemelerinde görülen sıkı beden ile iri karın değişkelerini birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Sıkı ve toplu beden yapısını, iri karın değişkeninden ayırarak birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hayvanın veya insanın beden yapısının toplu, sıkı ve güçlü olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Toplu görünüm ile sıkı ve güçlü beden yapısını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir erkeğin ayırt edici niteliği olarak karnının büyüklüğü anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İnsan katılımcısını ve karın iriliği niteliğini doğrudan korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Özellikle bir atın iki yanının dolgun ve dışa taşkın görünümü anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanın iki yanındaki kabarık ve dolgun görünümü korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: cinsel organı ve karnı iri olmak

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal iri veya şişkin karın görünümünde örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kısa boy gerektirmez ve hayvanlarda sıkı yapıyı da kapsar; komşu dal şişkinlik ile kısa, iri karınlı görünümü birleştirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sıkı hayvan yapısı ve kabarık yanlar gibi karın dışındaki betimlemeleri de içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yalnızca karnın çok büyük olması niteliğine odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal erkek kişide iri karın betimlemesinde örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Karın bağlamında yakın karşılık olabilirler; ancak odak dalın hayvan yapısı ve yanların kabarıklığına uzanan daha geniş bir değişke kümesi vardır.
